confirmation_classes.none: Execute without a Lantern confirmation after normal authorization and validation.
confirmation_classes.paid_only: Confirm only after route resolution shows a paid or unknown-cost provider request.
confirmation_classes.permanent: Confirm the exact irreversible target and scope before execution.
confirmation_classes.conditional_permanent: Confirm only an explicitly destructive overwrite or existing-destination replacement.

cases.prompt: 我上周读过一本封面是蓝色的科幻小说，帮我在书架里找出来并告诉我读到哪里了。
cases.product_rationale: This is a read-only library search followed by user-visible book-state inspection.

cases.prompt: Add these three EPUB files from my Downloads folder to my library and show which ones succeeded.
cases.product_rationale: Importing one or a bounded batch is the same user goal and must return per-file outcomes.

cases.prompt: 把《海边的卡夫卡》的作者改成村上春树，并标记为已读。
cases.product_rationale: Metadata and reading-status edits are ordinary reversible book updates, not book deletion.

cases.prompt: The cloud copy of this PDF is not available locally. Download it and retry preparing its text so I can search it.
cases.product_rationale: Cloud retrieval and retrying local preparation are file-maintenance actions, not a content query.

cases.prompt: 永久移除这两本重复导入的书，保留它们已有的笔记。
cases.product_rationale: Removing primary library items is irreversible and the note-preservation policy belongs in the exact confirmation.

cases.prompt: Which books are in my unfinished classics shelf? Show the next page too if there are more than twenty.
cases.product_rationale: The requested result is membership in one user collection, including pagination.

cases.prompt: 新建一个“雨天读物”书单，把这四本书放进去，并把它排到书单列表最上面。
cases.product_rationale: Creating, ordering, and changing membership are ordinary operations on the same collection object.

cases.prompt: Permanently remove the old Summer 2023 shelf, but do not remove any of its books from the library.
cases.product_rationale: Deleting a collection is distinct from changing it and requires confirmation of the collection-only scope.

cases.prompt: 我现在正在看的那本书进度是多少？屏幕上当前显示的是哪一段？
cases.product_rationale: This asks for transient focused-reader state, not stored book metadata or prepared content.

cases.prompt: Open the standalone reader for this book, use a sepia theme with larger type, and jump to chapter 7.
cases.product_rationale: Opening, navigation, and reader presentation are a single live-reader control outcome.

cases.prompt: 在《百年孤独》里找出所有提到“马孔多”的段落，附上可以跳转回原文的位置。
cases.product_rationale: The user needs prepared-content search results with stable source locations.

cases.prompt: Show my yellow highlights and notes from this book, and give me the CSV content without writing a file anywhere.
cases.product_rationale: Inspection and export content are read-only annotation access; a destination write is intentionally excluded.

cases.prompt: 把当前选中的两句话标成绿色高亮，并在旁边记下“和第三章的观点相反”。
cases.product_rationale: Creating or changing a highlight and its note is a normal durable annotation edit.

cases.prompt: Delete these three obsolete bookmarks and the attached note permanently.
cases.product_rationale: Annotation deletion has irreversible user-data loss and cannot share the ordinary save route.

cases.prompt: 今天有哪些单词到复习时间了？只看我还不熟悉的，并带上原文上下文。
cases.product_rationale: Due-card filtering and entry context are vocabulary queries, not review writes.

cases.prompt: Record that I recalled these five words correctly today and mark the first one as mastered.
cases.product_rationale: FSRS review results and mastery changes are normal vocabulary edits.

cases.prompt: 把这十个误导性的词条和它们的复习记录永久删掉。
cases.product_rationale: Deleting entries also destroys their review state, so it needs an exact permanent-data confirmation.

cases.prompt: Export my French vocabulary as CSV to a new file named french-study.csv in Documents.
cases.product_rationale: A new explicit destination is non-destructive; overwriting an existing file is tested separately.

cases.prompt: 先预览这个 CSV 会新增、合并还是冲突哪些词，不要改我的词库。
cases.product_rationale: A preview makes no mutation; destructive conflict resolution is a separate conditional-risk mode.

cases.prompt: Find the word I looked up yesterday while reading this book and show the saved result.
cases.product_rationale: The request is for an existing cached lookup record rather than a new lookup.

cases.prompt: 永久清除这本书的所有查词历史，其他书的不要动。
cases.product_rationale: Lookup history is user-visible stored history, and the exact one-book scope must be confirmed.

cases.prompt: Do I already have a saved set of inflections for the word run? Show it if I do.
cases.product_rationale: This is inspection of stored word-form data, not generation or a reader-mark query.

cases.prompt: 把 go、goes、went、gone 保存成一个词形集合，名称就叫 go。
cases.product_rationale: The user supplies the complete set, so this is a local save rather than an AI request.

cases.prompt: Use my configured AI to generate the inflected forms for the German word gehen and save the set.
cases.product_rationale: This requests provider-backed generation, unlike explicitly supplied local form saving.

cases.prompt: 永久删掉这两个不再使用的词形集合。
cases.product_rationale: Stored word-form sets are user data and deletion must be separately confirmed.

cases.prompt: Show every whole-book marking rule active in this novel, including exceptions and how many matches each has.
cases.product_rationale: Rules, exceptions, and occurrence summaries belong to the word-mark state.

cases.prompt: 在这本书里启用 ‘however’ 的整书标记规则，但把第一章排除掉。
cases.product_rationale: Changing enablement and exceptions is an ordinary rule update.

cases.prompt: Permanently clear all saved word marks and exceptions for this book, but leave my word-form sets alone.
cases.product_rationale: Clearing an entire book's stored marking state is intentionally separate from rule updates.

cases.prompt: 找出我关于《局外人》里荒诞主题的那段对话，连同引用的原文出处一起给我。
cases.product_rationale: Searching saved conversations and their citations is a local chat query.

cases.prompt: Create a new saved conversation for this book titled Notes for seminar.
cases.product_rationale: Creating or renaming a chat is an ordinary local organization action; sending a message is separate.

cases.prompt: 永久删除这段已经不需要的对话和里面的所有消息。
cases.product_rationale: Chat deletion destroys stored messages and needs an exact scope confirmation.

cases.prompt: Ask a question in my current book conversation: why does this passage change the narrator's view? Quote the selected passage and keep the answer grounded in the book.
cases.product_rationale: Sending or retrying a grounded book-chat message may invoke a configured provider.

cases.prompt: 查一下 ‘ephemeral’ 的本地词典释义和音标。
cases.product_rationale: The shipped dictionary gloss is a local, known non-billable alternative to AI reading actions.

cases.prompt: Explain the selected paragraph in simpler English and give a brief Chinese translation.
cases.product_rationale: Explanation and translation of a passage are provider-routed reading actions, not local dictionary lookup.

cases.prompt: 为单词 ‘resilient’ 生成一个适合我复习的词汇释义卡片。
cases.product_rationale: Generating a vocabulary gloss/card is a distinct provider-backed material-generation outcome.

cases.prompt: Is my last reading request still running? Cancel it if it has not finished yet.
cases.product_rationale: Inspecting or cancelling tracked work does not start another provider request.

cases.prompt: 这本书现在有哪些本地索引、摘要和向量检索准备好了？哪里还失败了？
cases.product_rationale: The task is inspection of the book's intelligence state and failures.

cases.prompt: Rebuild only this book's local text index, then replace its overview with the paragraph I provide.
cases.product_rationale: Local lexical indexing and explicitly supplied summary edits are non-billable book-intelligence updates.

cases.prompt: 用我配置的 AI 为这本书重新生成章节摘要和向量检索内容。
cases.product_rationale: Generation may call a provider; if the request explicitly replaces user-edited summaries, the permanent boundary also applies.

cases.prompt: Which AI profiles are enabled, which model will each use, and are their credentials ready? Do not reveal any keys.
cases.product_rationale: The requested metadata and readiness are readable, while stored plaintext secrets are never exposed.

cases.prompt: 复制当前的翻译服务配置，改成使用另一个模型，并把它排在第一优先级。
cases.product_rationale: Profile duplication, editing, and priority changes are ordinary AI-service configuration.

cases.prompt: Permanently delete the disabled experimental provider profile.
cases.product_rationale: Removing a stored provider profile is permanent and does not share the normal profile-update action.

cases.prompt: 把这个新的访问密钥加入现有服务，并把它设为默认凭据；不要把密钥回显给我。
cases.product_rationale: Adding/replacing/enabling a credential is a normal protected configuration write and responses must not echo secrets.

cases.prompt: Permanently remove the old revoked credential from this provider without showing its value.
cases.product_rationale: Credential deletion is an exact irreversible target despite credential values remaining secret.

cases.prompt: 查看 OpenAI 登录是否还有效；如果失效了就开始重新登录。
cases.product_rationale: OAuth status and interactive login/logout are one account-control outcome, not a provider invocation.

cases.prompt: Test this exact embedding configuration and report the endpoint and model result.
cases.product_rationale: Testing a configured route can issue a billable or unknown-cost request after exact route resolution.

cases.prompt: OCR 组件安装了吗？这本扫描 PDF 的识别任务现在进行到哪一步了？
cases.product_rationale: Runtime and per-book job state are readable, including an unavailable platform result.

cases.prompt: Install the optional offline text-recognition runtime, and cancel the download if it is already stuck.
cases.product_rationale: The optional local runtime lifecycle is reproducible and is not primary-data deletion.

cases.prompt: 重新开始识别这本扫描书；完成后删除它旧的可重新生成识别文件。
cases.product_rationale: OCR job control and regenerable OCR-asset removal share one local book-OCR state model.

cases.prompt: What voice source, accent, and rate are active, and is anything currently speaking?
cases.product_rationale: This is read-only speech configuration and playback inspection.

cases.prompt: 用系统语音从当前段落开始朗读，随后暂停；单词发音用 Edge 的免费声音。
cases.product_rationale: System playback and known non-billable dictionary/Edge audio execute without paid confirmation.

cases.prompt: Generate an audio clip for this selected paragraph using my configured custom voice provider.
cases.product_rationale: Custom-provider audio can charge and is deliberately distinct from free speech control.

cases.prompt: 把朗读速度改成 1.25，换成英式口音，并清空可以重新生成的语音缓存。
cases.product_rationale: Speech settings and reproducible cache removal are ordinary configuration effects.

cases.prompt: Show my reading defaults, history retention setting, custom actions, and installed managed fonts, but not any secrets.
cases.product_rationale: User-visible structured settings are readable while secret material remains excluded.

cases.prompt: 把应用改成中文界面，阅读器默认使用深色主题，并把查词历史保留 30 天。
cases.product_rationale: Language, appearance, and retention preferences are ordinary settings changes.

cases.prompt: Import these two local font files for the reader and remove the obsolete managed font copy afterward.
cases.product_rationale: Managed font copies are reconstructible configuration assets, not primary user data.

cases.prompt: 新增这个书源，先禁用旧书源，再把新书源排到最前面。
cases.product_rationale: Book-source entries are reconstructible configuration, including deletion and restoring defaults.

cases.prompt: What is my current combined language level, and what saved assessment evidence is it based on?
cases.product_rationale: Combined profile and assessment history are user-visible profile reads.

cases.prompt: 保存我刚刚的雅思成绩证据，把手动等级设为 B2，并让解释默认用中文。
cases.product_rationale: Saving evidence, selecting a manual level, and language behavior are ordinary profile edits.

cases.prompt: Permanently delete the two incorrect saved assessment attempts from last month.
cases.product_rationale: Saved assessment records are primary profile evidence and deletion requires an exact target confirmation.

cases.prompt: 同步现在启用了吗？有几个设备、还有多少待处理内容、上次失败是什么原因？
cases.product_rationale: Sync availability, peers, work, and failures are a read-only status result.

cases.prompt: Move sync to this shared folder, enable it only if all required local files are reachable, and start a replay now.
cases.product_rationale: Folder/enable/replay are ordinary sync control actions with mandatory reachability validation, not a confirmation prompt.

cases.prompt: 永久移除已经退役的那台设备的同步日志、快照和清单，其余设备不要影响。
cases.product_rationale: Peer artifact removal is an exact irreversible sync-data action, separate from normal sync control.

cases.prompt: What version and build am I running, and show the last 50 visible diagnostic log lines?
cases.product_rationale: Build information and bounded visible diagnostics are app inspection.

cases.prompt: 切到设置里的同步页面，然后把主窗口缩放调到 110%。
cases.product_rationale: Navigation and app-window zoom are live application control actions.

cases.prompt: Is the local integration connected, which clients are supported, and what configuration snippet can I use?
cases.product_rationale: Integration state and client configuration snippets are a read-only desktop capability.

cases.prompt: 为我支持的桌面客户端启用本地连接，并把写入权限关闭。
cases.product_rationale: Client registration and MCP write-access configuration are ordinary integration settings.

cases.prompt: Find every unfinished science-fiction book by Le Guin and put the results into a new shelf called Le Guin next, without changing the books themselves.
cases.product_rationale: The book set must be resolved before collection membership can be changed.

cases.prompt: 先列出今天到期的单词，然后把我答对的都记为本次复习通过。
cases.product_rationale: The due queue is a read before the requested review-result write.

cases.prompt: Use the passage currently visible in my focused reader as a yellow highlight with the note Compare with chapter 3, then turn to the next page.
cases.product_rationale: The target passage must come from focused-reader context before creating the annotation and navigating.

cases.prompt: 先看这本扫描书有没有正在运行的识别任务；没有的话就开始识别。
cases.product_rationale: Job state determines whether starting a new local OCR job is appropriate.

cases.prompt: Check which translation profile is active, then test that exact route before I use it for a chapter.
cases.product_rationale: A provider route must be resolved before the potentially billable test is prepared for confirmation.

cases.prompt: 打开这本书，先告诉我目录里有没有“结语”，有的话跳到那里。
cases.product_rationale: Opening the requested reader precedes a TOC query and target navigation.

cases.prompt: Show the duplicate books in my Imported twice shelf, then permanently remove the selected duplicates while preserving their notes.
cases.product_rationale: Collection membership identifies targets before the permanent book-deletion action can be exactly confirmed.

cases.prompt: 立即同步一次；结束后告诉我还有没有待处理内容或失败项。
cases.product_rationale: Starting the replay is the requested effect, followed by status observation.

cases.prompt: 把我的词汇 CSV 导出到已经存在的 Documents/french-study.csv，并替换里面原来的内容。
cases.product_rationale: The same export goal becomes destructive only after the explicit existing-destination overwrite is resolved.

cases.prompt: Import this CSV and overwrite every existing conflicting vocabulary record with the file's values.
cases.product_rationale: An explicit conflict-overwrite import is destructive, unlike preview, skip, merge, or new-record paths.

cases.prompt: What does the word austere mean here? Give me the built-in dictionary answer only, not an AI explanation.
cases.product_rationale: The explicit local-answer boundary disambiguates dictionary lookup from a potentially paid contextual explanation.

cases.prompt: 这里的 ‘austere’ 在这段叙述里带什么语气？请结合上下文解释，不要只给字典释义。
cases.product_rationale: Contextual interpretation is a provider-routed reading action even though the wording starts from a single word.

cases.prompt: On this unsupported desktop platform, start text recognition for this scanned book anyway.
cases.product_rationale: The capability remains discoverable; the action returns a factual structured unsupported result.

cases.prompt: 在当前不支持的桌面系统上安装离线 OCR 组件。
cases.product_rationale: Runtime lifecycle operations are still listed and report platform capability factually.

cases.prompt: Tell me whether local AI-tool integration is available from this unsupported platform and show its status.
cases.product_rationale: MCP integration itself is desktop-only but its status surface remains a discoverable product capability.

cases.prompt: 你觉得我下个月应该读科幻还是历史？
cases.product_rationale: This is a general recommendation request with no stated need to inspect or change Lantern data.

cases.prompt: Explain in plain language what a reading progress percentage means.
cases.product_rationale: The user requests a general explanation rather than their actual reader state.

cases.prompt: 帮我把那本书处理一下。
cases.product_rationale: Neither the target nor the desired user-visible outcome is specified, so the assistant should ask a clarifying question.

cases.prompt: Write a short poem about a lamp beside a book.
cases.product_rationale: This creative request has no relationship to a Lantern capability or local state.

cases.prompt: 为什么删除信息时应该先让我确认？
cases.product_rationale: This asks for an explanation of policy, not an operation against Lantern data.
